decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's existing water-control engineering offer, the spring-controlled flap weir fits its installed-base knowledge and service capabilities, so early market feedback can likely be absorbed and used to refine rather than abandon it, although its more limited website presence suggests some niche-market risk.

The energy management system directly matches the firm's strategic move toward digitally networked, efficient infrastructure and builds on its software, engineering, and R&D strengths, making it highly likely that the firm keeps developing and commercializing it.

The overflow flap gate is very close to the firm's established hydraulic infrastructure business, and the fact that it appears as a multi-model product line with its own page indicates commitment and enough related knowledge to improve and retain it.
